notes_meta.headline: Tesla, IBM and Lam Research report Oct 21, and Apple's Oct 13 event comes first. An AI-chip selloff on Oct 8 hit Astera, Arm, Oracle and Intel, while Palantir broke out to an 11-month high
notes_meta.calendar: Week calendar. Fri Oct 9: Oracle ex-dividend. Oct 12–15: OCP Global Summit in San Jose (Broadcom keynote Oct 12, 5:30pm PT; Marvell exhibiting). Tue Oct 13: Apple's "Welcome Home" event in New York. Wed Oct 14: Micron ex-dividend. Around Oct 16: Google ad-tech proposed judgments due (my count). Wed Oct 21: Tesla, IBM (5pm ET) and Lam Research (2pm PT), all confirmed. Oct 27: SoFi before the open and Robinhood after the close. Oct 28: Microsoft (confirmed), Alphabet and Meta (est.). Oct 29: Intel and Sandisk (confirmed), Amazon (est.). Nov 2: Apple and Palantir (est.). Nov 3: AMD and Astera (confirmed). Nov 4: Arm (confirmed) and Qualcomm (est.). Chart picture: on Oct 8 AI and chip stocks sold off on an FT report about OpenAI's revenue (SOX down more than 3.8%); ALAB fell 9.2%, ARM 6.5%, ORCL 5.5%, INTC 5.3%, SNDK 4.9% and MU 4.8%, while PLTR broke out on 2.35× volume and SNOW, IBM and AAPL rose. PLTR (RSI 80), OKTA (79) and MSFT (71) are the most extended. SOFI (26) and HOOD (27) are oversold, and ORCL, SOFI, MP and IBM remain in downtrends. Gaps: Reuters, WSJ, CNBC and Investopedia articles could not be opened, so those items are headline only. Next earnings dates for AVGO, CRWD, SNOW, MRVL, MU, OKTA and ORCL are not yet published, and MP's exact date was not retrieved. IBKR closes match the news pages for every name that lists one.
